topicName: Artifacts and Workspace Persistence Between Jobs
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Artifacts and Workspace Persistence Between Jobs in GitHub Actions"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"By default, every job in a GitHub Actions workflow runs in a fresh virtual environment instance. This means that changes made to the local workspace directory during one job are completely isolated and lost when the next job begins. To pass data, build outputs, or test results between jobs, you must use workspace persistence strategies, primarily through GitHub's artifact storage mechanisms."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Understanding the Difference: Workspace vs. Artifacts"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Workspace: The temporary local directory (GITHUB_WORKSPACE) where your repository is checked out and modified during a single job execution."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Artifacts: Files and directories produced during a workflow that are uploaded to GitHub storage, making them accessible to subsequent jobs or for manual download after the run completes."},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Step-by-Step Implementation"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"To demonstrate how to persist data between jobs, we will create a workflow with two jobs: a build job that compiles an application and uploads the output, and a deploy job that downloads the artifact and processes it."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"name: Persistent Workspace Tutorial

on: [push]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Create Build Output
        run: |
          mkdir build
          echo "Compiled application binary" > build/app.txt

      - name: Upload Build Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: compiled-app
          path: build/

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download Build Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: compiled-app
          path: build/

      - name: Verify Workspace Contents
        run: |
          ls -R build
          cat build/app.txt"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Key Configuration Details"},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"The needs: build statement ensures the deploy job waits until the build job completes successfully."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"actions/upload-artifact@v4 packages the specified directory and uploads it to the workflow run."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"actions/download-artifact@v4 retrieves the artifact and places it into the target path within the new job\'s local workspace."}]
